prepare_this_empty_drive_for_games: Prepare this empty drive for games
create_a_partition_in_unallocated_space: Create a partition in unallocated space
prepare_this_partition_for_linux_games: Prepare this partition for Linux games
linux_can_recognize_ntfs_however_differe: Linux can recognize NTFS. However, differences in permissions, links and filenames may cause launch failures, bugs and crashes with Proton/Wine.
you_can_keep_ntfs_and_leave_this_wizard_: You can keep NTFS and leave this wizard. Switching to ext4 or Btrfs requires formatting the partition and erasing existing data. This is not a conversion that preserves files.
a_gpt_table_and_a_partition_using_the_av: A GPT table and a partition using the available drive space will be created. This flow only accepts drives without existing partitions.
a_new_partition_will_be_created_only_in_: A new partition will be created only in this free space. Existing partitions will be preserved.
only_the_selected_partition_will_be_form: Only the selected partition will be formatted. Other partitions on the same drive will be preserved.
ext4_and_btrfs_are_linux_filesystems_win: ext4 and Btrfs are Linux filesystems. Windows does not normally access them without additional tools.
preparation_changes_the_drive_partition_: Preparation changes the drive partition table and erases any data on it.
old_data_remaining_in_this_unallocated_s: Old data remaining in this unallocated space may be erased.
formatting_will_erase_all_data_on_this_p: Formatting will erase ALL data on this partition.
check_the_device_and_capacity_even_witho: Check the device and capacity. Even without a recognized filesystem, recoverable old data may remain. Back up anything you need before continuing. This operation cannot be undone through the trash.
games_documents_photos_and_all_other_fil: Games, documents, photos and all other files will be lost. If it contains Windows, that installation will also be lost. Copy everything you need to another drive and verify your backup. This operation cannot be undone through the trash.
i_verified_the_device_and_confirmed_this: I verified the device and confirmed this space is empty or backed up. I authorize its preparation and formatting.
i_verified_my_backup_on_another_drive_an: I verified my backup on another drive and understand that all data on this partition will be erased.
a_simple_and_reliable_choice_for_a_game_: A simple and reliable choice for a game library.
linux_filesystem_with_features_such_as_s: Linux filesystem with features such as snapshots and compression, configured separately.
use_up_to_16_characters_starting_with_a_: Use up to 16 characters, starting with a letter or number. Allowed: unaccented letters, numbers, dots, hyphens and underscores.
the_partition_is_mounted_when_complete_e: The partition is mounted when complete, even if startup mounting is disabled.
use_in_more_than_one_linux_system: Use in more than one Linux system
so_another_linux_installed_on_this_compu: So another Linux installed on this computer (Ubuntu, CachyOS…) can also write to the drive. Any account on any system can create, change and delete files on it. Leave off if other people use this computer with their own accounts.
review_the_entire_drive_before_preparing: Review the entire drive before preparing
review_unallocated_space_before_creating: Review unallocated space before creating the partition
gpt_and_one_partition_on_the_empty_drive: GPT and one partition on the empty drive
new_partition_only_in_unallocated_space: New partition only in unallocated space
name: Name
the_drive_above_will_be_prepared_and_for: The drive above will be prepared and formatted.
only_the_selected_unallocated_space_will: Only the selected unallocated space will be used. Existing partitions will be preserved.
all_data_on_the_partition_above_will_be_: All data on the partition above will be erased.
close_games_and_files_on_this_drive_the_: Close games and files on this drive. The system requests administrator authorization when needed; the launcher does not receive or store your password. After starting, wait for completion; do not disconnect the drive or shut down.
to_authorize_preparing_and_formatting_th: to authorize preparing and formatting this entire drive.
to_authorize_creating_and_formatting_a_n: to authorize creating and formatting a new partition in this free space.
type_confirm_to_prepare_and_format_the_e: Type confirm to prepare and format the entire drive
type_confirm_to_create_a_partition_in_un: Type confirm to create a partition in unallocated space
type_confirm_to_erase_the_partition: Type confirm to erase the partition
close_this_wizard_and_refresh_drives_to_: Close this wizard and refresh drives to inspect the current state before making any further changes.
waiting_for_authorization_or_preparing_t: Waiting for authorization or preparing the partition…
